description: Timeout and Deadline have the same severity (1). t.a is cancelled with Timeout at 10 and then Deadline at 20; t.b with Deadline at 10 and then Timeout at 20. On equal severity the earlier timestamp wins (strengthen's tie-break), so each keeps the kind it was first cancelled with, stamped 10, and neither request moves the budget (both kinds grant 500 polls at priority 210).
